api_analysis.hypothesis: The compile error is caused by calling __device__ function ceil_div from __host__ launcher functions. This happens because ceil_div lacks __host__ qualifier, so it is only available on device. The minimal fix is to add __host__ __device__ qualifiers to ceil_div so it can be used in both host and device code.
evidence: Compile log: 'calling a __device__ function("T1 ::ceil_div<unsigned long> (T1, T1)") from a __host__ function("squeeze_launcher") is not allowed'

ceil_div is defined as template <typename T> __device__ __forceinline__ T ceil_div(T a, T b)
Launchers squeeze_launcher and add_scalar_launcher are host functions that call ceil_div with size_t arguments
changes: Modify ceil_div declaration to be __host__ __device__ so it can be called from host launchers
No other changes needed; softmax1d_launcher does not call ceil_div and is correct
